comments.text: Blond, heavily built, and tall. That's how he was described in the books, and that's exactly what we are getting!!! I love Tom Cruise as Reacher, but this.... this is just perfect.

comments.author: @PathkeeperOfficial
comments.text: Everything about it is perfect. The took pains to capture the characters and personalities from the book, the unexpected clever comments and zingers delivered in Reacher’s classic brevity, even the fight scenes feel more like “we need a fight scene now because this is Reacher and we haven’t done one in about 10 minutes” which is how I imagine Lee Child’s process was as well. They didn’t cherry pick the plot points and dialogue that would have been easy to adapt; they made the series wholesale off the book in as many ways as possible.
